description: Pulses its output for one pass when the signal on its enable rises, falls or changes in either direction.

activation.text: Samples the enable on every pass, including the passes when it is off. The first sample only sets the starting level.

enable.description: The signal watched for edges. Connect a signal to the enable so Edge can detect its changes.

eno.description: A one-pass pulse when the chosen edge occurs.

fields.description: Which change of the signal makes the block pulse its output.

options.description: The signal changes from false to true.
The signal changes from true to false.
The signal changes in either direction.
